text:
marta: quick heads-up: saw a brief p99 spike in continuous-batcher tied to tenant 'alpha' burst. thinking about queue ownership vs soft-reserve.
kieran: numbers?
marta: p50 ~10ms, p99 120->760ms for ~4m. enqueue wait high.
joy: micro-lanes isolate but risk fragmentation and idle GPUs.
ben: shared lanes + soft-reserve (burst tickets) keeps packing but needs deterministic eviction order.
kieran: we don't have lane-level histograms yet. need telemetry before big rollout.
joy: proposal: implement burst-ticket bucket per tenant that regen slowly; when empty, tenant gets deprioritized.

ben: admission tweak: add deadline_bias to coalesce score = deadline_hint / est_tokens * factor. favor tight deadlines.
marta: token estimates come from model heuristics; log misorders for tuning.
derek: rollout path: behind FF, telemetry + canary 5-10% tenants, rollback if p99 > 2x or GPU occupancy drops >15%.
ops-bot: incident IN-2026-03-22-11 created and assigned to marta.
marta: action items: kieran - telemetry sketch; joy - ticket sim; ben - eviction draft; derek - canary runbook. will sync tomorrow.
